text:
Priya (Recruiter): Hi team — final check for Thurs 3/12 candidate (K. Nguyen). It's a 90m loop: 45m pairing (pairing VM), 30m debrief, 15m buffer. Need: Room A, 1 extra laptop with Linux + Docker, proctor (non-scoring) and debrief owner. Can someone confirm room + debrief owner? Also want rubric note: how do we score collaboration vs implementation for pairing? Thanks!

Will (Eng): I can grab Room A and bring a spare laptop. Will the pairing env be a GitHub repo + docker-compose? :thumbsup:

Priya (Recruiter): yes — pairing repo: github.com/redwood-inference/pairing-exercises/tree/main/cli-svc. Dockerfile + README included. Candidate will share screen, interviewer will drive at times.

Samir Patel: Quick rubric ask — for pairing, we usually weight 40% code correctness, 40% collaboration, 20% problem framing. Do we want to keep that or mark collaboration higher for this role? Also, how strict on hints? i.e., score if you gave >2 hints.

Maya (People Ops): Standard rubric is fine. For this role (infra platform) I'd bump collaboration to 45/35/20 (collab/code/framing). For hints, note in debrief if you gave more than 2 hints; we don't auto-penalize but context matters.

Jordan Lee: heads-up I have a conflict last minute — can swap with Will on debrief owner if needed. I can cover debrief if Will wants to do pairing.

Will (Eng): I can do pairing + laptop; Jordan take debrief then. Works for me.

Priya (Recruiter): Perfect. Jordan, you're debrief owner. Maya, can you mark interviewer roles in Greenhouse? Also adding 20m timezone buffer — candidate in PST, interview scheduled in EST. I'll post updated invite.

Maya (People Ops): Done — roles updated in Greenhouse. Also created an extra calendar buffer of 20m after the session for notes. :white_check_mark: 

Priya (Recruiter): calendar invite snippet:
```
Thu Mar 12 15:00-16:30 EST
15:00-15:45 pairing (Room A)
15:45-16:15 debrief (Room A / call)
16:15-16:30 buffer
```
Candidate TZ: PST (12:00-13:30 PST)
Please don't finalize any follow-ups during buffer slot so debrief can be captured.

Jordan Lee: One more thing — accessibility note: candidate requested larger font and clipboard for typing. Will bring keyboard and increase font in the VM.

Will (Eng): I'll set editor font to 16, install tmux and set terminal font. Also I'll SSH into the VM ahead of time and confirm docker runs.

Priya (Recruiter): Thanks all. Last ask — add a short debrief form link to invite (copy below). Jordan will fill within 1 hour after interview.
Debrief form: https://forms.redwood.ai/interview-debrief

Calendar Bot: Reminder set — 24h and 1h before. Room A reserved (Desk 4).
